name: Truth of Mind ~Kokoro no Yami ni Hisomu Akuma to Tenshi~
original_name: Truth of Mind ～心の闇に潜む悪魔と天使～
source:
One day a rape case occurs in a theater that main character is guarding. Owner of the theater asks protagonist to investigate this case discreetly so that theater reputation does not suffer. Girls willingly cooperate with investigation, but then second and third rape cases occur as if criminal wants to ridicule the investigator. Will hero be able to catch the culprit and protect cute theater girls?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
某天，主角负责警卫的剧场发生强奸案。剧场老板担心名誉受损，请他秘密调查。女孩们主动配合，可第二、第三起强奸案仍接连发生，仿佛犯人有意嘲弄调查者。主角能否抓住凶手，保护剧场里的可爱女孩？

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
